arguments.question: For ANET, assess the operating thesis and valuation over the mandate horizon. Use current issuer filings/results, normalized SEC facts, the dated completed close, and timestamped analyst-consensus source if usable. Cover revenue/EPS/margins and guidance, AI/networking demand, customer concentration, competition and supply; keep management guidance separate from analyst estimates. Compute and interpret (1) a bear/base/bull EPS×P/E grid for the authoritative fiscal period, including residual EPS versus reported interim EPS, fixed-input break-even EPS and P/E, joint earnings/multiple risk and stipulated upside/downside asymmetry; and (2) one three-method calculation with forward P/E, EV/revenue and five-year DCF per-share values, explicit assumptions, reverse expectations and reasons the methods diverge. Required deliverable: concise sourced facts, causal mechanisms, competing explanations, conditional valuation conclusions, gaps and observable thesis-change conditions. Stop once the three methods and operating bridge are reproducible from the best available primary/current sources; report timestamped consensus or targets unavailable rather than infer them.
arguments.decision_impact: Establish whether ANET's operating outlook and explicit valuation sensitivities support, condition or block a directional research assessment; this is the core business and valuation input.
